name: appear
description: When the entrance starts, in seconds from the clip's start; before it the canvas is clear.

name: hold
description: Seconds from the entrance's start until the exit starts; the visual is complete by then at speed 1.

name: exit
description: Leave with a short exit motion (0.4 s) after hold; false keeps it in place until the clip ends.

name: speed
description: Plays the entrance and the inner motion (typing, counting, building) faster above 1 or slower below; hold and the exit keep their seconds.

name: theme
description: White cards with dark text, or near-black cards with light text.

name: accent
description: The accent colour of highlights, bars, buttons and selections.

name: width
description: Canvas width in pixels; the template's own when omitted. The design scales to fit, so a larger canvas renders it sharper.

name: height
description: Canvas height in pixels; the template's own when omitted.

name: duration
description: Length in seconds; when omitted, appear plus hold, plus 0.4 s for the exit when exit is on.

name: fps
description: Frames per second; the template's own when omitted.
